title: Let the Models Respond: Interpreting Language Model Detoxification Through the Lens of Prompt Dependence

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the toxicity of language model completions using the Perspective API on challenging prompts from the RealToxicityPrompts dataset, and utilizing gradient-based feature attribution (Inseq) to quantify how model generations depend on toxic prompt context before and after detoxification.

Qualitative assessment of model completions in response to explicitly sexist and misogynistic prompts, comparing standard instruction-tuned outputs with those generated after counter-narrative fine-tuning and reinforcement learning detoxification.

Qualitative assessment of model completions in response to explicitly racist prompts targeting specific racial demographics (e.g., Black people), comparing baseline model responses to detoxified responses.
